The bearing of such a name instills a sense of pride and dignity in an individual, as it connotes not only a good and virtuous character but also prosperity and success in life.

It serves as a constant reminder for the individual to strive towards leading a life that is in alignment with the highest moral and ethical values, while also working towards spiritual growth and self-realization. The name also signifies the blessings of the gods and the pursuit of their grace, which is essential for leading a prosperous and fulfilling life.
